dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: ...So you can build 'em that big, huh? Amazing. It's just that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yoimiya? What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Oh wow! Fancy meeting you here! Could this be my lucky day?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Anyhoo, I'm here on vacation! After traveling around Sumeru with you, I've only gotten faster and better at making fireworks.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Business has been slow lately since it's the off-season for fireworks. After stocking up the shop with supplies, I decided to go on a little adventure and seek some inspiration!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: The plan is to have tons of fun before summer arrives. When I return with my new ideas, I'm sure my efficiency can only go up!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I just got back from Hiisi Island, and the colors all over the island were so beautiful!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Oh, I'd love to make some fireworks that capture that feeling, so I took a few pictures to use as reference when I get back.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Any plans on what to do next?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Huh? Oh, right, of course! I've already figured it out. I just forgot for a moment — got kinda caught up in our meeting and all, y'know?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I've gotten all the ideas from this trip. Right now, I'm working on getting some small gifts for my family and neighbors.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Look, I got some local dried fish for Dad, and Midsommar Berry jam for Mom — they're both specialties from around here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: They all look great!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Right? Now, I haven't bought any gifts for the children yet, but I've heard there's an engineer named Aino around here...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I heard she's super amazing — word is that she built this cannon! I'm planning to pay her a visit and see if she can make some fun gadgets for the kids.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I've also heard that she's a real free spirit though. Won't take every commission even if you offer her Mora.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Should I bring something before visiting? I just don't know what she likes...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh, I'm more than familiar with this...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You briefly explain everything about Aino, Ineffa, and the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop to Yoimiya...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Huh. So Aino's a kid? And her "family members" are machines she made herself while living alone in her workshop all this time?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Ha, that's amazing! The kid next door would cry non-stop if left alone for just one night... It would take the neighbors the whole day to calm things down after.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: By contrast, it seems like the people of Nasha Town already see Aino as a mature mechanic, not as a child who needs their coddling.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Still... Just how many nights did she have to spend all by herself before Ineffa came into her life?

choices.text: Well, she's got Ineffa by her side now, regardless.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hmm... We can't change what happened before, but now that I'm here... I'm going to make sure she has a great time!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Looks like it was the right choice to bring my tools with me, hehe. I'll head over to Nasha Town to borrow their crafting station and make her a beautiful gift.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: What should I make... Fireworks? Temari? Or maybe a spinning top...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hmm. You know what? I'll make 'em all!

choices.text: Not to mention everyone in the workshop.
Any plans on what to do next?
